newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK February manufacturing output.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK February manufacturing output.

text.p: Following is a list of reactions to UK industrial production and manufacturing output data published at 0830 GMT. The figures showed manufacturing output up 0.2 percent in February and 1.8 percent higher year-on-year.
"Clearly the back revisions are important and are positive, but at this stage manufacturing still clearly lags behind the services sector."

"My initial guess about the fall in industrial production is it represents a fall in oil extraction from the North Sea and softer utility output due to the mild weather in March. But it is the manufacturing side that is important and with the upward revisions to the January data it is slightly stronger than expected."
MARIAN BELL, ROYAL BANK OF SCOTLAND

"Mild weather in February led to a fall in industrial output due to lower electricity and gas production. The year-on-year rise in manfacturing output is slightly better than expected and could limit the extent of moves in the market." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7715
